# Ronak Bhatt — Ruby on Rails & React Full-Stack Developer

> Ronak Bhatt is a full-stack developer based in London, Ontario, Canada with 8+ years of experience in Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vue, Node.js and AWS. He builds scalable web applications, upgrades legacy Rails apps, designs APIs, tunes performance, and works remotely with teams in Canada, the US, the UK and Europe. Upwork Top Rated Plus. Taking on freelance and contract projects; also open to the right full-time role.

## Services

- [Web development](https://www.ronakbhatt.in/services): Rails monoliths, React and Next.js front-ends
- [Rails upgrades & maintenance](https://www.ronakbhatt.in/services/rails-upgrade): framework upgrades on existing apps, tested so existing features keep working
- [Backend & API architecture](https://www.ronakbhatt.in/services): data models, REST and GraphQL APIs, background jobs, integrations
- [Rails maintenance & support](https://www.ronakbhatt.in/services/rails-maintenance): ongoing upkeep, updates, fixes and deploys
- [Hire a Rails developer](https://www.ronakbhatt.in/services/hire-rails-developer): freelance, contract or long-term engagements
- [React & Next.js development](https://www.ronakbhatt.in/services/react-nextjs): front-ends, landing pages and dashboards
- [Performance tuning](https://www.ronakbhatt.in/services): slow pages and queries, caching, N+1 fixes
- [Code review & CI/CD](https://www.ronakbhatt.in/services): refactoring proposals and delivery workflows
- [Web design](https://www.ronakbhatt.in/services): landing pages and responsive UI
